Appearance move to sidebar hide From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Lord of Montpellier from 1058 to 1068 William IV (or Guillem IV ) was the Lord of Montpellier from 1058 until his death in 1068. [ 1 ] He was the son of William III and Beliardis. He was married to Ermengarde, daughter of Raymond I, Count of Melgueil . He is the first of his dynasty with charters preserved in the family cartulary , the Liber instrumentorum memorialium . They record agreements concerning some local castles in 1059. [ 1 ] He was succeeded by his son, William V . Notes [ edit ] ^ a b Archibald R. Lewis, "The Guillems of Montpellier: A Sociological Appraisal", Viator , 2 (1971), 159–60.
